_doc: Key risks block — Ciridae-style callouts above sub-factor cards. Merged into profiles.json at build. Agent output: contract/key_risks.json + data/key_risks/batch*.json

reference_pattern.ciridae: 2–3 cards max; warning icon; entity-specific mechanism; named competitor or structural gap
reference_pattern.nfri: Each card ties to a sub-factor or cover_stack gap; cites source URL when available; states mining pass to close

schema.title: Short headline (≤8 words)
schema.body: 2–4 sentences: mechanism, what is insured today, what breaks, honest tier label
schema.mining_gap: Which pass closes this: trigger_mining | register_pull | sfcr_mining | entity_analysis | …

generation_rules: Prefer entity_analysis.infirm_risk_profile.dimensions[] and risk_manifestation[] over generic rubric text
If measured share <20%, lead with provisional card naming top 2 assessed sub-factors by weight
trigger_gap ≥2: name absent trigger type (availability, parametric, BI-without-damage) from cover stack
L4: aggregation_correlation + cedant UK power/DC concentration
Never duplicate executive_summary; each card must add a distinct underwriting angle
